finding: A verifier must not treat a previously valid JWKS as indefinitely reusable. Cache freshness must be bounded, an unknown token kid must trigger one synchronous refresh, and stale or non-matching keys must fail closed when refresh cannot produce one unique RSA key.

source_status.supports: GitHub Actions issues OIDC tokens for workload identity and provider-side validation.
The provider metadata jwks_uri identifies the JWK Set used to validate signatures.
HTTP cache freshness is finite and stale responses require explicit handling or successful validation.
JWK Sets carry keys and kid values used to select among keys during rotation.

uncertainty: No live GitHub JWKS response headers were retained in this run.
The one-hour hard maximum is a conservative project policy, not a GitHub guarantee.
The artifact selects an eligible JWKS but does not perform network retrieval, TLS validation, JWT signature verification, replay prevention, or workflow authorization.
falsification_route: Retain live discovery and JWKS response headers from token.actions.githubusercontent.com.
Exercise a controlled key-rotation fixture where a new kid appears after the cache was populated.
Demonstrate that any stale-key fallback can accept a token that the refreshed key set rejects; such a result confirms fail-closed outage behavior is required.
